title: Analysis of Categorical Data
description: Prerequisite: STAT430 and STAT420; or permission of CMNS-Mathematics department. Loglinear and logistic models. Single classification, two-way classification; contingency tables; tests of homogeneity and independence models, measures of association, distribution theory. Bayesian methods. Incomplete contingency tables. Square contingency tables - symmetry. Extensions to higher dimensional contingency tables.
